horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Yiida Buinama y el origen del maguaré. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: H04 — Gente acuática · modelo comparativo Muinane. Distinct adult human water people, not fish hybrids: first adult bare head and pale nose quill, short cobalt EAR tuft / black-red seeds; second adult LOW emerald/charcoal feather band, two cream curved pendants, no nose pin. Cream raw-fibre garments have different simple dark FRONT trim and small blue-grey / ochre accents, no uniform mythical sea-people robe. Never put ornaments on actual fish support.
Reference 2: V11 — Yiida: devolución y maguaré. 
Reference 3: L10 — Umbral entre agua y maloca. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide violet twilight river-to-maloca threshold. TWO whole clothed adult aquatic visitors from the HUMAN views in H04 stand on the low wet bank carrying the TWO broad wooden split-log bodies of the emerging maguaré in V11. They have natural warm brown skin and plant-fibre clothes, no fish faces, scales on human skin or alien glowing race. The sound bodies retain subtle curved kuio-like origins in their lower paper edges, not a worm glued to a drum. One transition: the instruments come from the water world to the leaf-roofed communal house. River, earth and doorway are continuous, no display sheet or modern drum kit. Entire carriers and log forms fit inside.

VISIBLE CHECK: Dos visitantes completos llevan los dos cuerpos del maguaré desde agua a casa.

vertical.escena:
Use case: image editing. Edit OUR OWN AI-GENERATED paper-cut original, reference image 1. Make one independent full-bleed artwork in vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536.

CORRECTION:
Retain exactly TWO whole foreground adults: the original long-haired father with the low green feather ring at far left, and the original mother with the ochre-front cream dress and cobalt ear feather (third figure from left). REMOVE the red-tuft male and red-neck-chevron female. Reposition the retained father and mother on opposite sides of the exactly TWO whole slit-log drums, gently lowering the drums onto their supports. Pull back about 30 percent so both whole adults, every shoulder, hand and foot, and both full logs fit inside the vertical frame with air at both sides. Preserve the amber maloca interior and blue water seam to the doorway. No extra people, no drum striking or extra instruments.

Preserve expressive physical matte cardstock, actual separated layer shadows, pale cut cross-sections, hand-cut curves, folded feather vanes and leaf midribs. Quiet natural paper-plane faces, no CGI, plastic or digital painting. The environment continues beyond all four borders; no frame, plinth or specimen-sheet layout. No printed text. Every principal whole body, head, hand, foot, wing and ornament tip must remain inside the canvas. Retain the original color relationships and traditional fibre covers. These are original editorial illustrations, not certified traditional symbols. No private photo, real-person likeness or ritual instructions.

MYTH: Yiida Buinama y el origen del maguaré. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: O07 — Maguaré — dos cuerpos sonoros. 
Reference 2: L03 — Río · ribera baja y paso. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE PAIR of whole split-log MAGUARÉ bodies is a single relational carrier, side by side on low supports, entirely visible. The two longitudinal slit openings are continuous with ONE lifted BLUE RIVER RIBBON that rises between them and expands in concentric cut-paper SOUND ARCS. Wood becomes voice from water: original editorial metaphor, not notation or a certified musical sign. No people, hands playing, letters, waveform diagram, extra drum or literal worm. Dark amber timber and bright teal-blue raised paper establish the crossing from origin to communication in an intimate full-bleed maloca-shadow world.

VISIBLE CHECK: Dos cuerpos con ranuras conectadas a una sola cinta de agua que se abre en ondas.
